Expense Policy

Guidelines for submitting and approving expenses.

What Is Reimbursable

  • Travel: flights, trains, and taxis for business
  • Meals: within the per diem limit
  • Software: pre-approved tools

Per Diem Rates

RegionDaily Limit
Europe75 EUR
North America90 USD

Receipts are required for any single item over 25 EUR.

How To Submit

File claims in the finance portal within 30 days. See the Approval Workflow for routing.
